claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No purchase date, usage history, or wear indicators visible in the single photo; age cannot be confirmed remotely.
No power-on test, spin cycle, or drum photo/video provided to confirm functionality.
Back/base panel and motor housing not shown; no way to check for prior repair or tampering.
Documents not photographed; existence and validity unconfirmed.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or complete a wash/spin cycle
risks.proof: Video of unit plugged in, filling, agitating, and spinning with audible motor sound

risks.risk: Internal drum, bearings, or motor could be worn, rusted, or damaged
risks.proof: Photo inside drum and underside/motor area, plus close-up of bearings

risks.risk: Missing accessories (inlet/outlet hoses, lid, control knobs)
risks.proof: Full photo set showing all sides including back, control panel, and accessory bag
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete set, worst case missing parts

risks.risk: Hidden leaks, cracks, or rust not visible from front angle
risks.proof: Photos of back, base, and underside of unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as if damage present until shown otherwise

risks.risk: Actual age/usage could be older or heavier than claimed
risks.proof: Clear photo of receipt with date and model/serial match to unit label
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, not 'barely used'

proof_requests: Video of machine running a full wash and spin cycle
Photos of the back, base, and control panel of the unit
Close-up photo of the receipt and warranty card matching the model/serial number
Photo inside the drum and of the motor/pump area
Confirmation of model/capacity label or serial number
response.reason: Identity (NEXUS washing machine) is confirmed by the witness, but all seller claims about condition, age, and documentation are unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
